name: Badal Mohanty/ ବାଦଲ ମହାନ୍ତି

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Badal Mohanty writes poetry and fiction in Odia and is associated with Barsha Publication in Bhubaneswar. Reports of the publisher’s literary events identify him as its director. His books include the novel Fula Rasiya Re; a report of the 2023 Barsha festival also records the launch of his novels ମାଇଚିଆ and ମାୟାମଞ୍ଚ alongside prose recollections.

In his two-part poem “ଶୂନ୍ୟସ୍ଥାନ,” a school exercise in filling blanks opens into an inquiry about absence. Childhood friendship, loss and a love remembered across forty years give the empty space changing meanings. The poem comes to value what cannot be filled: a voice, a memory, a place another person continues to occupy.
